subject: Bespoke channel packaging credit for CloudBridge pilot — request for VP/CFO clearance
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Sato <paul.sato@cloudbridge.io>, procurement@cloudbridge.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot packaging & onboarding credit proposal

Paul / team —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — CloudBridge’s channel model and co-sell plan look like a great fit with our Dedicated offering. Per our conversation, CloudBridge is planning a 6-month pilot across 3 mid-market accounts with bursty inference usage (primarily nightly batch scoring + 1–2 live endpoints). To accelerate partner commitment they’ve asked for a one-time onboarding credit tied to the pilot.

Attached is the draft MOA and a proposed pricing grid showing the requested uplift. Quick summary:
- Pilot length: 6 months
- Estimated consumption: ~2.4M tokens/month (initial months), expected to grow 30% after month 2
- Asks: one-time onboarding credit of $50k OR 40% off first 3 months consumption (whichever triggers higher uptake)

We see three practical outcomes: convert to multi-year channel commitment, shorten sales cycles across co-sell motions, or low ROI and churn. Given the channel leverage and potential ARR (we estimate $480k ARR at conversion), I’m recommending we grant a tailored credit but shape it as a consumption rebate tied to conversion milestones to protect unit economics.

Can Marissa / Ben help surface a concise memo for VP/CFO approval? Ideally we request clearance for: up to $50k total credit but with a preferred structure of $25k upfront + up to $25k rebate contingent on conversion to a paid 12-mo contract within 9 months. If approved, I’ll share the MOA with CloudBridge and push to finalize signatures this week.

Attachments: CloudBridge_MOA_20270415.pdf (MOA draft), proposed-pricing-grid.xlsx (breakdown)

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
Redwood Inference | developer-first inference runtime
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot packaging & onboarding credit proposal

Dylan —

Thanks for the write-up. Two quick asks before I escalate to Marcus:
1) Can you quantify expected gross margin impact across the pilot window (best / base / downside)? I want a 6-month P&L delta showing the credit and projected revenue.
2) Please confirm what guardrails we can include in the MOA to avoid open-ended credits (usage caps, monthly true-ups, clawback if no conversion).

Ben — assigning to you to pull the model and draft a short table. I’ll draft the executive memo once we have the numbers.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-04-19T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot packaging & onboarding credit proposal

Marissa / Dylan —

Attached is a quick model (tab: sensitivity) with three scenarios. Highlights:
- Base case: revenue $144k over 6 months, gross margin after infra & support ~$48k (33%) without credit
- With $50k upfront credit: margin drops to $-2k (breakeven) in pilot window but conversion upside improves ARR to ~$480k
- Alternative (recommended): $25k upfront + $25k milestone rebate tied to executed 12-mo contract within 9 months yields pilot window margin ~$11k and retains conversion incentive

Guardrails suggested for MOA: monthly token caps per account (soft cap + 20% burst threshold), formal monthly usage true-up, and a 50% clawback if conversion fails within 9 months. Also propose conversion trigger be a signed order for 12 months at minimum committed spend.

I’m attaching the spreadsheet: proposed-pricing-grid.xlsx (included scenario tabs and the recommended memo paragraph).

Ben Carter
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T14:33:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Bespoke packaging credit approval — CloudBridge pilot

Marcus —

As discussed briefly in revenue ops sync, requesting VP/CFO clearance for a bespoke channel package credit for CloudBridge’s 6-month pilot. Summary below (full attachments linked).

Ask: approval to grant up to $50k total in pilot credits, with a preferred structure of $25k upfront + up to $25k milestone rebate conditioned on conversion to a 12-mo paid commitment within 9 months.

Rationale:
- Partner co-sell motion expected to drive faster pipeline across 3 mid-market accounts (forecast conversion probability 22% over 12 months; expected ARR ~$480k on conversion)
- Pilot consumption is bursty; upfront credit materially reduces friction for partner integration and demo-to-production cadence
- Proposed guardrails (recommended by Sales Ops): monthly token caps, monthly true-ups, and 50% clawback if no conversion in 9 months — limits downside and preserves predictable unit economics

Impact: Base-case pilot revenue $144k, pilot-window gross margin ~33% without credit. Under the preferred structured credit the pilot window margin reduces to ~7% (as modeled). Net present value improves if conversion triggers (see attached spreadsheet).

Requested decision: Approve the structure above (25k upfront + 25k contingent rebate) OR deny and instruct us to return with an alternative (e.g., smaller upfront credit + higher rebate threshold). If approved, we will:
1) Finalize MOA with CloudBridge this week
2) Route consumption rebate to billing as a conditional credit tied to signed order
3) Kick off partner-revenue tracking in the Console with token-level cost breakdowns and monthly reports to Revenue Ops

Attachments: CloudBridge_MOA_20270415.pdf, proposed-pricing-grid.xlsx

Thanks for taking a look — happy to hop on a 15-min call if you want the model walked through.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
